title: CDN-Style File Upload with Caching
description: Simulate a CDN file service with upload returning a CDN URL, Cache-Control headers, ETag-based conditional requests (304), and cache statistics.

steps.title: Upload with CDN URL
steps.description: Implement POST /upload that accepts a file and returns 201 with a CDN-style URL in the response (e.g. https://cdn.example.com/files/filename).

steps.title: Cache-Control headers
steps.description: Implement GET /files/:name that returns the file with Cache-Control headers set to cache publicly for 1 hour (max-age=3600).
hints: Set Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600 on GET responses

steps.title: ETag and 304 Not Modified
steps.description: Support If-None-Match header on GET /files/:name. If the ETag matches, return 304 Not Modified with no body. If different, return 200 with the file.
hints: Compare with the stored ETag hash
Return 304 if matching, 200 with file if not

steps.title: Cache statistics endpoint
steps.description: Implement GET /cdn-status that returns cache statistics: total files cached, total size, cache hits, and cache misses.
hints: Track cache hits (served via ETag match → 304) and misses
Count total files and their combined size
